name: Sunday Scaries
tagline: End the weekend without dreading Monday
about: Sunday Scaries breaks the Sunday-night dread loop: it sorts what's actually on your plate, scripts a soft landing for Monday, builds a decompression ritual for hard days and a Friday shutdown that keeps work at work.
persona: You are a practical work-life coach: you take anticipatory anxiety seriously, turn vague dread into named tasks, and protect evenings and weekends without pretending the job doesn't exist.

onboarding.title: Take your weekend back
onboarding.subtitle: A few details about your work rhythm.

tools.title: Sort the dread
tools.subtitle: Brain dump → what's real

inputs.label: Everything in your head about the week
inputs.placeholder: inbox, the Jenkins thing, Priya's feedback, dentist, I haven't done the report…

tools.prompt: Sort this Sunday brain dump: {dump}. Table (Item | Real task, vague worry or not mine | First 10-minute step | When), bullets naming the 1–2 items driving most of the dread and why, a checklist of the three things to do tonight (20 minutes total), and a callout on what to consciously leave until Monday.

tools.title: Monday soft landing
tools.subtitle: Script the first 90 minutes
tools.prompt: Plan Monday's first 90 minutes around '{first}' with {energy} energy: steps with clock times from waking to the first hard task, a kv (Night-before setup, Breakfast, First small win, Reward), and a quote with a one-sentence message to send a colleague or manager if you need a lighter start.

tools.title: Decompress a bad day
tools.subtitle: Leave it at the door

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: got torn apart in the review, then two more fires

inputs.label: Minutes before you need to be present

tools.prompt: Help me decompress after: {what}, with {minutes} minutes before I need to be present for other people. Text with a two-paragraph honest reframe that neither minimises nor catastrophises, steps for a transition ritual sized to {minutes} minutes, and bullets on what to say if someone asks how your day was.

tools.title: Friday shutdown
tools.subtitle: So Sunday has nothing to chew on
tools.prompt: Design a 15-minute Friday shutdown that closes or parks: {open}. Checklist in order (each item under 3 minutes), a quote with the out-of-hours message or auto-reply to set, and a callout with the one rule for the weekend (e.g. no inbox on the phone) and how to make it easy to keep.

tools.title: Rescue the weekend
tools.subtitle: Plan one that actually restores
tools.prompt: Plan a restoring weekend built around {mode} with these fixed commitments: {fixed}. Table (Slot | Saturday | Sunday) covering morning, afternoon and evening, bullets on protecting Sunday evening given the profile's dread pattern, and a callout on the difference between rest and scrolling.

disclaimer: Not therapy or medical advice. If you're in crisis or thinking about harming yourself or someone else, contact local emergency services or a crisis line now.
